result.text: Okay, so we're up to פרק ו', and so we talked about how חסידות brings new life into everything, and we talked about how that's connected to the the the idea of משיח as the reward of חסידות, and from that we can and חסידות משיח is the idea of the revealing of the יחידה, this new life into things into the world from the level of יחידה. Okay, so כמאמר אל, like we mentioned previously, משכרה של הפצת החסידות ביאת המשיח, נדע את מהותה. From the reward, like we said, from the reward of a מצוה, we can know the nature of the מצוה. So, from the reward of הפצת המעיינות of חסידות, which is the bringing of משיח, we can know the real מהות, the true nature of חסידות. כל החידושים שהחסידות חידשה בתורה, גילוי הויה זה חלק הסוד שבו לידי גילוי, בעבודת האדם, הנהגה דלפנים משורת הדין ושינוי מידה, טבע מי המידות, both everything that חסידות accomplishes as in terms of תורה, which is the idea that that the secrets of the תורה, the קבלה, is revealed, and in a person's עבודה, that it's able a person can go beyond the letter of the law and change the nature of his מידות, one second, so he says in the in the note here that when serving God on the levels of נפש, רוח, נשמה, and חיה, a person's really still maintaining their original identity and sense of self. And so their so when he's serving God, it's it's really for some sort of extrinsic motivation that can have some sort of result from it that they want. And so the nature of his מידות is not changed. He's just using the nature of those מידות which already have a natural love for God. But the level of יחידה, however, a person can have this complete ביטול where he totally goes beyond his existence and, therefore, he doesn't have any self-interest and his service of God is truly לשמה, truly for God's sake, which is the idea of going beyond the letter of the law. And number two, the very nature of his מידות is also able to change from חסד to גבורה, גבורה to חסד, and things like that. A person can go out of their nature. Okay, and ובכללות העולם, and the effect of חסידות in the world, התעוררות מעילוף, which the idea of like, we said waking up from a state of faint or this comatose state. So, all of those things that חסידות accomplishes, all those four things, אינם חידושים שכל אחד ואחד מתחדש הוא בפני עצמו. They are not individual things that חסידות does this, and it does that, and it's, you know, puts all of them together. כי אם שהחסידות הוא חיות חדש, rather, חסידות brings new life, חיות עצמי מבחינת יחידה, this essential life of the יחידה, וכאשר חיות חדש זה של החסידות נמשך בעולם, and when this new life of חסידות comes into the world, תורת חסידות הכללית על ידי כ"ק בעל שם טוב, הרב המגיד וכו' ואחר כך תורת חסידות חב"ד על ידי הנשמה חדשה, כ"ק קדושת אדמו"ר הזקן, בעל השמחה והגאולה, so when חסידות is brought into the world, first through the general חסידות was brought through the בעל שם טוב and the מגיד, etcetera, and all the other, you know, Rebbes of חסידות in general, and then חסידות חב"ד was brought about through the new soul, which is the אלטער רבי, who is the בעל שמחה and גאולה of י"ט כסלו when this was originally said, and, by the way, I just wanted to point out, you know, this book has a lot of really nice footnotes we're not going through right now, and actually the Rebbe commented about one of the Rebbe's doctors, one of the Jewish doctors, Dr. Resnick, was once walking with the Rebbe, sometimes he would early in the morning before everybody was around Crown Heights would take walks with the Rebbe and talk to him, and he talked to him about you know, he was studying this, and he noticed that the footnotes are more than the actual book. And the Rebbe said something to the effect that that's like the whole connected in some way to the whole idea of חסידות and and that you know, there's you know, I guess so much more you know, the understanding explanation is like you know, unlimited, it's much more than just the simple thing that you read, something like that. So, it's they're very rich, all these these things they have here, it's worth taking a look at, but since right now we're really learning this as a companion to שער היחוד, I'm not getting so into all these things. But okay, so through חסידות being revealed, התחילו כל עניני העולם לחיות בחיות חדש, חיות עצמי, וממילא נתחדשו בהם כמה וכמה ענינים. So when חסידות was revealed, automatically that new life, it brought this new life into the world, and when the when that new life is brought into the world, automatically it accomplished all those other four things. So those four things we talked about originally that חסידות accomplishes are symptoms of the fact that חסידות is bringing this new life, the life of יחידה, the life of משיח, into the world. Okay. פרק ז. גם מטעם זה נמשלה תורת החסידות לשמן, רזין דרזין. And this is also why חסידות is compared to oil, which represents the secrets of the secrets. In קבלה, wine represents the סודות, the רזין, the secrets of the תורה, and oil represents the secrets of the secrets, the יחידה. And like we mentioned before, there are three, when we looked carefully, there were like three aspects to the relationship of an essence to what comes out from that essence: on the one hand, the essence transcends all of the details; on the other hand, it unites all of the all the things that come out from it, all the four levels; and the third aspect is that it's actually the entire essence is found within each of the details, within each of the four. And those three things are expressed in this idea of oil, this metaphor of שמן. So שמן הוא נקודת התמצית, essence, של כל דבר. Oil represents the essence of everything. ומזה מוכרח שמצד עצמו מובדל הוא מכל דבר, and from this itself, it necessitates that oil is really something that transcends any particular thing. כי אם היה לו שייכות לדבר פרטי, if it had a relationship to just one particular thing, לא היה יכול להיות נקודת התמצית של כל דבר, it couldn't be the essence of everything. And I think the idea is that like we see, there's crude oil that comes from rocks, and then there's vegetable oils that come from plants, and then there's fats that are in animals, and so we see that there's this idea of oil is something that exists on like every level of of existence, and it's not particular to any one creature or one thing, but it's something more general and more transcendent. אלא שהוא בחינת עצמי, it's rather something essential, fundamental, ולהיותו עצמי, נמצא הוא בכל דבר, and therefore it's found in everything. כי העצמי נמצא בכל, because something that's essential is found in everything. So we see on the one hand that that oil is something that transcends any particular thing, and and because of that, it's able to be found within everything. ודבר זה, and this idea, ככל הענינים שבפנימיות התורה, like everything in פנימיות התורה. So this is an idea in פנימיות התורה, this this concept of oil representing, being a metaphor for an essence, and an essence being something that transcends the details, but yet is found in all of them, and it's like a a unifying commonality between all things, that this So this concept in פנימיות התורה, in קבלה and חסידות, is also expressed, נתבטא גם בנגלה דתורה, is also found in Torah law, עד בהלכה למעשה, not only in גמרא, but all the way to practical הלכה. מצד אחד, on the one hand, השמן אינו מתערב בשאר משקין, we find that for certain laws, there's a concept that oil does not mix with other liquids. So there's an idea that let's say you have oil floating on top of wine or water, and somebody or something טמא that's impure touches the oil, the oil will not transfer, at least according to, you know, certain situations, according to some opinions, it will not transfer that to the other liquids because it's considered to be separate from them. Even though it's kind of touching them, but since its nature is to float above them, it's it's considered to be separate from the other liquids. ולאידך גיסא, on the other hand, מפעפע הוא בכל דבר, we find that in other laws, when that something that's oily or fatty, it says, will bring the transfer a flavor into an entire thing. So let's say you have a very fatty piece of meat, let's say, or something like that, and you cook it with something else, whether it's another piece of meat or some other dish, we say that that the flavor is not just going to is not just going to penetrate the outer layer, it's going to actually the oil is going to carry that flavor and have it penetrate all the way through and through the entire other piece of food. So that's the idea that we see that oil is something that that permeates everything. So on the one hand, it floats on top and remains separate from everything, and on the other hand, its nature is to spread and permeate into everything. ולכן נמשלה תורת החסידות לשמן, and this is why חסידות is compared to oil, כי גם בה שתי תכונות אלו, because חסידות also has these two qualities. מצד ענינה העצמי, when you're speaking about what חסידות When you're looking at that essential state, אינה מתערבת בשום דבר, it doesn't mix into anything, and like, like these two ideas in הלכה, when oil is in a liquid state, we say that it will float on top of everything, on top of other liquids. But when you have have it come in contact with something like solid, then we say it's going to permeate into that solid. ואידך גיסא, on the other hand, מתפשטת היא ומפעפעת בכל דבר ודבר כנ״ל. But on the other hand, חסידות is something that spreads into and permeates everything. Like we mentioned before, that חסידות is expressed in all dimensions of תורה: פשט, רמז, דרוש, and סוד. So, it's essentially something higher than פשט, רמז, דרוש, סוד. It's this essential godly point, but that essential godly point is something that can be found and gives new life to everything in תורה, and through that, also to everything in the world, and also in the microcosm of every aspect of a person's life. Okay, ח׳. החיות שתורת החסידות מכניסה בכל ענייני העולם, קטן, זה האדם, והעולם כפשוטו, the life that חסידות brings into everything in the world, both the microcosm of man and the world, the general world in its simplest sense, נמשכת מהחיות שחסידות מכניסה בכל ענייני התורה ובאה על ידי חיות זו, comes from the fact that חסידות first brings life into תורה, and through giving this new life to the different levels of תורה, the פשט, רמז, דרוש, and סוד of תורה, those different aspects of תורה then give new life to the different aspects of the world and the different aspects of a person. So, it's through first learning חסידות, bringing that חסידות into the understanding of the תורה, on the פשט, רמז, דרוש, סוד level, that's how we then affect the world, the per-, well, really, that's how we affect a person, and then through changing a person, we're able to then affect the world around us, too. כי כל, כי כל ענייני הבריאה נמשכים מהתורה ובאים על ידה, because everything in creation comes from תורה. I'm not sure what this double, it's drawn from the תורה and it, and it's accomplished through it. I'm not sure what the, the implication of those double, that double expression is. So, it's worth thinking about. Whenever it looks like they're being poetic, it's not. It's always very precise, but I'm not, I'm not sure what the implication is. Okay. בתורה ד׳ חלקים, תורה has four parts: פשט, רמז, דרוש, and סוד. The simple meaning, which is like the story-like level where it's just telling stories, it's telling the history and these kind of things. רמז is like the metaphoric meaning, like he's going to say, which relates to the outside world, really where you're connecting, seeing the stories as examples of general principles about the world at large, and it relates also to more like a scientific type of level, understanding the world. דרוש is like the level of תורה ומצוות, morality and and תורה ומצוות. And סוד, the level of the secrets of תורה, that relates to ספירות and godliness. ותורת החסידות מכניסה חיות בכל אחד מהם, and חסידות brings new life into each of these four aspects of תורה. אשר, נוסף על זה שבתורת החסידות באו ביאורים לעניינים שונים שבכל ד׳ חלקי התורה, not only in, in addition to the fact that חסידות explains different topics from each of these four parts of תורה, שגם זה שולל את הסברא שחסידות באה בכדי לבאר את חלק הסוד שבתורה בלבד, which this itself disproves the common misconception that חסידות is really just an explanation of קבלה, that it was like קבלה for the masses, that's not really correct. It does explain קבלה in a way that people could relate to, but that's not the, it also explains things in פשט, רמז, and דרוש. But in addition to explaining different topics in each of these parts, לימוד החסידות מכניס חיות בכל ענין וענין, learning of חסידות brings new life, this new life that we talked about of יחידה into each and every topic, בכל חלקי פרד״ס שבו, in every, but, in, in each topic it brings a new life to the, each of these four levels of that topic, the פשט, רמז, דרוש, and סוד of that topic, שלומדים בתורה, that we learn in תורה. So whatever topic we're learning in תורה, if we, we can learn it on the level of פשט, רמז, דרוש, and סוד, but if we bring חסידות into the equation, it will give new life to all of those levels. שחי הוא באופן אחר לגמרי, it now takes on a life, it begins to live with a completely, in a completely different way, בחיות עצמי, with this essential life. וחיות זה מוסיף גם בהירות ועומק יותר בהבנת הענין, and this new life also adds much more clarity and depth to the understanding of the topic. And, you know, I think this is a very common and unfortunate problem that, that a lot of times times we can learn a topic, you learn some גמרא, you learn a מדרש, you learn whatever it is, a פסוק with רש״י, and a lot of times like there's not really a real understanding of the idea. It's not really something that we really can understand and and really something that we really experience. It's just like we just like kind of trust the תורה and trust חז״ל and say, "Well, that's what it says," and we just repeat it, but it doesn't really have that full depth of understanding to it. So, חסידות helps, you know, make that connection where each idea is something that we can really fully see and experience, and see it in ourself, and see it in the world, and really, you know, get what on a much, you know, deeper level what what the תורה is saying, what חז״ל are saying, things like that. So, דוגמא לזה בנגלה דתורה והלכה, and so this a comparison to this relationship of how חסידות brings a new life to to everything, we find also once again in נגלה of תורה and in הלכה, in the revealed parts of תורה, and even in practical law. כל עבודת יום הכפורים אינה כשרה אלא בו. There's a concept that on יום כיפור, all of the service in the בית המקדש had to be done by the כהן גדול, the כהן גדול. So normally, the כהן גדול you know, would do certain things in the בית המקדש, but he didn't do everything. The regular כהנים did most of the things. The regular קרבן תמיד, the morning sacrifice and the evening sacrifice, lighting, you know, lighting the מנורה, bringing the קטורת, other people would do it. Once in a while, the כהן גדול would do it, maybe, but it was didn't have to be done by him. כמו שקדושת יום כיפור מועילה לעבודה המיוחדת ליום כיפור, כך היא פועלת גם בהתמידין ומוספין דשבת, השייכים מצד עצמם לכל ימי השנה, שגם הם מתקדשים בקדושתו של יום הכפורים. So יום כיפור, in addition to the fact that it brings a special quality, uniqueness, that there's a special עבודה that relates to the day of יום כיפור that's more special than, you know, the rest of the year, but not only does it have its own unique עבודה, it also elevates and changes the regular offerings and regular service that was done on a regular weekday or on a regular שבת, and all of that, which really relates to the whole year, now is made holy with the holiness of יום כיפור, and therefore it's imbued with this deeper level of holiness, and it's done has to be done in this special unique way with the כהן גדול. And this the idea that יום כיפור represents the level of יחידה, and that's why there were five we like we have five שמונה עשרה's on on יום כיפור as opposed to you know any other time of the year we just have three or four, because it relates to the יחידה, and the כהן גדול represents the יחידה, and and everything like that. וכן הוא גם בנוגע לתורת החסידות, in a similar way, this is the way it is with חסידות, בחינת שבת שבתון שבתורה, which is the יום כיפור is called the שבת שבתון, the the שבת of all שבת's, and so on this which is the level of יחידה. And חסידות is a similar thing, it's the level of יום כיפור of the תורה. And so just like יום כיפור doesn't just bring its own new holiness, but also elevates everything else that now it also becomes on a higher level. So in a similar way, חסידות, שפועלת היא בכל חלקי התורה, it affects all the other dimensions of תורה. כי ד' החלקים פשט רמז דרוש סוד שבתורה הם ד' הבחינות נפש רוח נשמה חיה שבתורה, because the other four parts of תורה, the פשט, רמז, דרוש and סוד, correspond to the four levels of soul, נפש, רוח, נשמה, חיה. ותורת החסידות היא בחינת יחידה שבתורה, and חסידות is the יחידה of the תורה, ומצד גילוי היחידה מתעלים גם הנפש רוח נשמה חיה כנ״ל. And like we mentioned previously, that when the יחידה is revealed, that also then elevates and brings new life to the level the lower levels of the soul, נפש, רוח, נשמה, חיה, and so that's in a similar way, חסידות elevates the פשט, רמז, דרוש and סוד and gives a new life and depth to it, and through that it also elevates and brings new life to the four worlds, עשיה, יצירה, בריאה and אצילות and everything, like we'll see all this ties together. Okay, so let's stop here for now, and yeah, it's not it's not such a long קונטרס, so
